{{Top|notoc=1}} {{Character |type=Bounty hunter |image=[[File:Bric_SWCT.png]] |name=Bric |homeworld=[[Mileva]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' |birth= |death= |species=[[Siniteen]]{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/clone-cadets-episode-guide|text="Clone Cadets" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{TCW|Clone Cadets}} |pronouns=He/him |height=1.91 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|ft]], 3 in) |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Yellow]] |skin=Pale gray |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]] {{C|contracted}} **[[Grand Army of the Republic]] {{C|contracted}} |masters= |apprentices=*Many [[clone cadet]]s **[[Bravo Squad (clone cadets)|Bravo Squad]] **[[Domino Squad]] }} {{Quote|Your actions have brought out the ''best'' in these cadets.|Shaak Ti, to Bric|}} '''Bric''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Siniteen]] [[bounty hunter]] who, along with his partner, the [[Arcona]] bounty hunter [[El-Les]], was hired by the [[Galactic Republic]] to train [[clone cadet]]s during the [[Clone Wars]] after the [[death]] of [[Jango Fett]]. He held the rank of [[Master Chief]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|This particular unit seems to have some trouble. What do you recommend?''"
"''Well, I'm no Jedi, so forgive my bluntness, but I say they fail. Send them down to maintenance with 99 and the other rejects.|Shaak Ti and Bric|}} Bric was a [[Siniteen]] bounty hunter hired by the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]] to train various [[clone cadet]]s in the wake of [[Jango Fett]]'s [[death]].{{Topps|set=2021 Topps Star Wars Bounty Hunters|cardname=Bric|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/263568/cid/18708464}} As a [[drill sergeant]]{{HelmetCollectionCite|8|Databank A-Z}} under the rank of [[Master Chief]], Bric worked to oversee clone trooper training in [[Tipoca City]] with fellow bounty hunter [[El-Les]]. When dealing with a particular clone cadet squad called [[Domino Squad]], Bric was very impatient with their struggles. He began to give up hope and told El-Les that they would never become competent soldiers. When Domino Squad attempted to conquer the [[Citadel Challenge]], Bric was highly critical of their inability to function as a unit and later had to break up a fight between troopers [[Hevy|CT-782]] and [[Echo|CT-1409]] in the barracks. The next day Bric and El-Les rallied Domino Squad and other cadet units on a hangar deck to take a lesson from the [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC troopers]] of [[Rancor Battalion]]. Commander [[Colt]] addressed the troopers and watched the next attempt at the Citadel Challenge. Bric praised the first group, [[Bravo Squad (clone cadets)|Bravo Squad]], and told Colt that Domino Squad was inept. They watched as the group failed the test again, much to Bric's amusement. That night, he chewed out clone trooper [[Cutup|CT-4040]], saying that he was "a real cutup" and blamed him for his squad's struggles. Much to his dismay, CT-4040 took the nickname "Cutup" and drew inspiration from the criticism. When [[Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti]] came to personally oversee Domino Squad's progress and next attempt at the Citadel Challenge, Bric decided to set back Domino Squad further by removing their [[Ascension gun|ascension cables]] so they could not climb the citadel at the end of the challenge. When El-Les learned of his actions, he told the Jedi to stop the test, but Domino Squad pulled together and conquered the challenge despite the setback, much to the chagrin of Bric. Nevertheless, the Siniteen was also impressed. ==Personality and traits== [[File:BricSmirk-CC.png|thumb|left|250px|El-Les and Bric's feelings toward Domino Squad often clashed.]] A Siniteen [[Gender|male]] bounty hunter, Bric stood 1.91 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|ft]], 3 inches), had [[Color|yellow]] [[eye]]s and pale gray skin. Bric was a hard-nosed bounty hunter and tough taskmaster with little patience for trainees who did not meet his high standards. His bullying was in contrast to El-Les's gentler approach and kindness to training clone cadets. ==Skills and abilities== As Bric was a bounty hunter entrusted with training clone cadets on Kamino, he was known for his exceptional leadership and military tactics. He was also skilled in tracking and reconnaissance. ==Equipment== The bounty sported green-yellow–colored [[armor]] during his time on Kamino. The armor's chest piece featured three vertical red lights located on the left side. Bric also carried a [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]] in a holster on his right leg. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Clone Cadets}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Fugitive}} ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Bric}} *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode301.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Clone Cadets}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]] *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/clone-cadets-episode-guide|text="Clone Cadets" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/fugitive-episode-guide|text="Fugitive" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} *{{SWE|groups|clonetroopers|clone troopers}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|8|Databank A-Z}} *[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] *{{SWCT|set=Base Series 4|cardname=Bric}} *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' *{{Topps|set=2021 Topps Star Wars Bounty Hunters|cardname=Bric|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/263568/cid/18708464}} *{{Databank|arc-trooper-fives|ARC Trooper Fives}} {{Po}} *{{Databank|clone-troopers|Clone Troopers}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Bric |fr=Bric |ja=ブリック |pl=Bric}} [[Category:Bounty hunters]] [[Category:Grand Army of the Republic personnel]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Kamino residents]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Siniteen]]
